title: Novelty Plasma Orb
description: A large, transparent plasma globe sits on a black metallic base, emitting vibrant glowing tendrils of yellow, orange, pink, and blue light from a central electrode. Inside the sphere, a small silhouetted human figure stands on a platform while an orange vintage car is visible in the left background.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene featuring a massive transparent plasma ball on a sleek black and chrome base labeled SLOT-17 SEED 34356 NOVELTY PLASMA. Bright neon tendrils of yellow, orange, pink and blue energy radiate from a glowing central orb. A small human silhouette stands inside the sphere. An orange vintage car appears in the dark background to the left. Cinematic lighting, vibrant glowing atmosphere, futuristic gallery setting.
